says.description: The name as the line says it, where it differs. Default: name.

kind.description: What kind of business it is, for the agent model ("a public library").

voice.description: How the line sounds, in the business's own words, for the agent model: the persona.

owner.description: The owner's name, where the line refers to the owner ("Dana").

oneOwner.description: true: the business is one person, and the line never speaks of a team. For the agent model.

examples.description: Replies the owner wrote, to show the agent model the tone: examples, never rules and never facts. Measured on 2026-11-09: with them, no reply held a figure the facts do not. Default: none.

business.description: Who the business is and how it sounds.

name.description: The service as the line names it ("holds").

about.description: What it is, in the business's words: something the line may say.

services.description: What the business does: the only services the line speaks of.

notOffered.description: What it does not do, which the line may say it does not ("book sales"). Default: none.

claims.description: The reassurance the line may give, in the business's words: the only claims, and the only place a turnaround or a promise may come from. Default: none.

background.description: Context for the agent model only, never said as a claim. Default: none.

prices.description: How prices are given. Without it, the line has no price line to say.

quote.description: How a price is given, for the agent model ("at the desk"). Never a figure.

say.description: The price line, said word for word when a caller asks about price: the line never says a figure.

place.description: Where the business is, in its words: something the line may say.

mobile.description: true: the business also comes to the caller. Default false, which the line may say.

days.description: The days of the week it works, which the line may say. Default: none said.

windows.description: The windows of the day, which a choice field takes with options: windows. Default: none.

name.description: The window's name, as a choice field with options: windows takes it and the read-back says it ("morning").

says.description: What the window is, in the business's words, which the line may say ("from 9 to noon").

capacity.description: How many requests or bookings the window takes, for the app's own calendar. Never said by the line.

items.description: One window of the day something is dropped off or collected in.

accounts.description: The regular accounts, each with the numbers it calls from. Needed by a booking. Default: none.

name.description: The account's name, as the line and the read-back say it ({account}).

numbers.description: The numbers the account calls from (E.164): a call from one of them is recognized as the account, by caller ID. Caller ID can be forged: the policy card says what a forged number could do.

items.description: One regular account, booked straight in.

request.description: What any caller's request collects, its read-back, the tools a yes calls and its done line.

about.description: What the form is for, as the agent model is told ("a hold on a book, collected in a pick-up window"). Default: the form's name.

label.description: The form in a few words, as the line names it ("send a request"). Default: the engine's words for the form.

name.description: The field's name: the read-back's and the done line's {placeholder}, the param of the same name in every call the form makes, and the name the agent model gives its value by (for example callerName, day).

type.description: The slot type from the library the value is checked by (docs/slots/README.md): choice, date, digits, name or text. birthdate is refused (an identity factor's type, and the conversation is sent to the agent model). A type that takes no value from outside its own fill (record, reference, topic) is refused, since in agent mode the model understands the value and the slot type checks it.

question.description: The field's question, said word for word when the line asks for it in fixed words (the agent's reply was not said, or the field is next and nothing else is): its ask_<form>_<field> line.

about.description: What the value is, for the agent model ("The title of the book, as the caller gave it."). Default: none, the field's name alone.

options.description: A choice field's options: a list of the words each option is said by ("one", "not sure"), or "windows", the names of the business's windows. Only on a choice field, which needs it.

optional.description: true: the form may be read back without it. Default false: the read-back waits for it.

length.description: A digits field's number of digits (10 for a phone number with its area code). Only on a digits field, which needs it.

offer.description: A digits field that may be the number the caller is calling from: "callerNumber" offers it (the slot's callerNumber). Only on a digits field.

countryCode.description: With offer: callerNumber, the country calling code the carrier writes before the number ("1" for +1), taken off the number calling to fill the field. Default "1".

sees.description: A tool whose result the agent model may see once the field is filled (the maintainer's decision 2): the tool, in the app's code, is called through the gate with the field's value, and its result, checked by the tool's reply check in a closed form, reaches the model. For example availability, for a day.

redact.description: How the value is masked wherever it leaves the turn, as its slot type takes it: a digits field last4 (its default), length or none; a text field none only (its default), since its value is read back as the line understood it; no other type takes one. length-summarized is refused: in agent mode the conversation is sent to the agent model, so a value kept only by its length would be sent whole. Default: the slot type's own.

items.description: One field a form collects: its name, its slot type and its fixed question.

fields.description: What the form collects, in the order its fixed questions are asked.

readBack.description: The read-back: the line, in fixed words, that says what the line understood, with each field's value as its slot type displays it ({name}), and asks the caller to confirm it. A yes sends the form's `then` to the gate.

then.description: The tools a yes at the read-back calls, in order, each through the gate: the first is the form's write. Each is called with the form's values by field name (and, on a form for accounts, the account as `account`), and each carries exactly what the caller confirmed. A tool follows one form only.

done.description: The line said, in fixed words, once the form's tools have run, with the values as {placeholders}.

for.description: Who may book: "accounts", a caller the number they call from matches to one of `accounts` (identity level 1 by a caller-ID match). Any other caller may not.

done.description: The line said, in fixed words, once the form's tools have run, with the values as {placeholders}.

greeting.description: The line a call opens on, in fixed words. Default: "Thanks for calling <says>. How can I help?"

handoff.description: The line said when a caller asks for a person, in fixed words: a callback, not a transfer. A statement, not a question ("I'll have someone from the desk call you back."): it is said where nothing waits for an answer, and the callback form, where there is one, asks for the number.

closing.description: The line a call ends on, in fixed words.

owner.description: Where requests and bookings go: the owner's number and the summary sent. For the app's own tools.

notify.description: How the owner hears of each request and booking: "text", a text message (printed until texting is registered), or "print", printed only.

summary.description: The owner's summary of each request and booking, a fixed template with the values as {placeholders}: never a generated line.

tools.description: What each tool a form calls does, in a few words, by its name ("placeHold: place the hold"): the action's description on the policy card, the console and the audit. Default: the tool's name in words.

lines.description: The engine's own lines in the business's words, by id (nomatch_open, no_input, anything_else, goodbye_chat, ...), in place of their defaults. Default: the engine's words.
